description: This file defines the ProxyDrawable class, a custom drawable that acts as a wrapper or proxy for another Drawable object, delegating rendering and attribute methods to the internal mProxy object.

classes.name: ProxyDrawable
classes.description: A custom Drawable implementation that proxies calls to an internal Drawable object, allowing for dynamic replacement and extending drawable behavior.

methods.name: ProxyDrawable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ProxyDrawable with a target Drawable.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Sets a new proxy Drawable, ensuring it is not self-assignment.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Delegates the draw call to the proxy Drawable if it exists.

methods.name: getIntrinsicWidth
methods.description: Returns the proxy Drawable's intrinsic width, or -1 if proxy is null.

methods.name: getIntrinsicHeight
methods.description: Returns the proxy Drawable's intrinsic height, or -1 if proxy is null.

methods.name: getOpacity
methods.description: Returns the opacity of the proxy Drawable, or PixelFormat.TRANSPARENT if null.

methods.name: setFilterBitmap
methods.description: Sets the bitmap filtering option on the proxy Drawable.

methods.name: setDither
methods.description: Sets the dithering option on the proxy Drawable.

methods.name: setColorFilter
methods.description: Applies a ColorFilter to the proxy Drawable.

methods.name: setAlpha
methods.description: Sets the alpha transparency value on the proxy Drawable.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Ensures that the proxy Drawable is mutated correctly, avoiding shared state issues.
